definitions.explanation: The positive sign (+) in mathematics. Opposite of {負|ふ} (negative).
Indicates something is correct, proper, or legitimate.

notes:
{正|せい} is used as a prefix or noun meaning "positive" (math) or "correct/official."

MATH USAGE:
- {正|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: positive number
- {正|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{符号|ふごう}→符号：00042_fugou⟧: plus sign (+)
- Opposite: ⟦{負|ふ}→負：09512_fu⟧ (negative)
- ⟦{正|せい}{三角形|さんかくけい}→正三角形：23664_seisankakukei⟧: equilateral triangle

MEANING "CORRECT/OFFICIAL":
- ⟦{正|せい}{解|かい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧: correct answer
- ⟦{正|せい}{式|しき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧: official, formal
- ⟦{正|せい}{社員|しゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧: regular (full-time) employee
- ⟦{正|せい}{門|もん}→正門：04350_seimon⟧: main gate

CONFUSION ALERT:
- {正|せい}: positive, correct
- ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made in/of (⟦{日本|にほん}{製|せい}→日本製：28455_nihonsei⟧ = made in Japan)
- ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: nature, gender, -ness

These homophones are common sources of confusion.
